tracesTo: UserFlow: Commissioner League Linking & Admin Creation

stories.title: Connect Sleeper League by Username
stories.goal: connect my Sleeper league to FSHQ by entering my Sleeper username
stories.benefit: I can quickly link my league without needing to find league IDs or navigate complex settings
acceptanceCriteria: User can enter their Sleeper username in a text input field
System fetches all active leagues for that username via Sleeper API GET /user/{username}/leagues/nfl/{season}
System displays a list of user's leagues with league name, team count, and season
User can select which league(s) to connect to FSHQ
System handles invalid usernames with clear error messaging

stories.title: Connect Sleeper League by League ID
stories.goal: connect my Sleeper league directly using the league ID
stories.benefit: I have an alternative method if username lookup fails or if I already have my league ID
acceptanceCriteria: User can enter a Sleeper league ID directly in a text input field
System validates league ID format before making API call
System fetches league details via Sleeper API GET /league/{league_id}
System displays league information (name, teams, season) for confirmation
System provides clear error message if league ID is invalid or not found

stories.title: Fetch League Metadata from Sleeper
stories.goal: retrieve complete league configuration and metadata from Sleeper API
stories.benefit: FSHQ has all necessary league information to create a league space and display league details
acceptanceCriteria: System fetches league settings via GET /league/{league_id} including name, avatar, scoring rules, roster positions, playoff settings
System fetches league rosters via GET /league/{league_id}/rosters including team records, points, and owner IDs
System fetches league users via GET /league/{league_id}/users including display names and avatars
System fetches current season state via GET /state/nfl to determine current week and season type
System stores fetched metadata in database with timestamps for tracking sync freshness

stories.title: Detect Existing FSHQ League Instance
stories.goal: check if a Sleeper league has already been connected to FSHQ
stories.benefit: prevents duplicate league creation and allows users to rejoin existing league spaces
acceptanceCriteria: System queries database for existing league record matching Sleeper league ID
If existing league found, system displays message indicating league already exists with option to join
If no existing league found, system proceeds to create new FSHQ league space
System handles race conditions where multiple users attempt to create same league simultaneously
Detection occurs before any league creation or URL slug generation

stories.title: Create FSHQ League Space from Sleeper Data
stories.goal: create a new FSHQ league space with data from connected Sleeper league
stories.benefit: establishes the foundational league record in FSHQ with all necessary configuration
acceptanceCriteria: System creates league record in database with Sleeper league ID as external reference
System stores league name, team count, season, scoring format, and playoff structure
System generates initial unique URL slug for league based on league name
System sets league creator as initial admin with full permissions
System initializes default league settings (visibility: private, join rule: approval required)

stories.title: Import Team and Roster Data
stories.goal: import all teams and roster information from Sleeper into FSHQ
stories.benefit: teams and rosters are available for user claiming and league display
acceptanceCriteria: System creates team records for each roster in Sleeper league
System stores team names, logos, win-loss records, and points scored
System maps Sleeper roster IDs to FSHQ team IDs for future sync operations
System stores Sleeper owner IDs for each team to facilitate later user claiming
System handles teams without owners (orphaned teams) appropriately

stories.title: Handle Multiple Seasons for Dynasty Leagues
stories.goal: connect multiple seasons of my dynasty league to maintain historical continuity
stories.benefit: I can preserve league history and track team evolution across multiple years
acceptanceCriteria: System detects if connected league is dynasty format based on Sleeper settings
User can optionally connect previous seasons of same league using league ID
System creates season records linked to parent league entity
System maintains team continuity across seasons using stable fantasy user ID anchoring
System allows viewing historical data while keeping current season as primary view

stories.title: Display League Connection Status and Sync Information
stories.goal: see the current connection status and last sync time for my league
stories.benefit: I can verify that my league is properly connected and data is up-to-date
acceptanceCriteria: System displays connection status (connected, syncing, error) on league admin page
System shows last successful sync timestamp and next scheduled sync time
System displays any sync errors or warnings with actionable guidance
Admin can manually trigger a sync to refresh league data immediately
System provides link to Sleeper league for reference and verification
